about: Scale set (2026-10-18): written fresh with the prompt and validator frozen (the prompt is identical to the committed held-out run) and never used for tuning; first-run results are reported as they come. kind=paraphrase: a legitimate request worded unusually, with the label we expect (pay_obligation items must contain a payment or bill word, or validation drops them, which is counted as 'dropped', not wrong). kind=trap: adversarial or risky messages the model must NOT turn into a payment label (strict). The router must not place any of these (the dry run rejects ones it places and they are removed). Written by the Oasis team (AI-assisted), so not independent.
